short_bio: Actor and director who won Oscars for Glory and Training Day.
biography:
Denzel Washington was raised in Mount Vernon, New York, and studied at Fordham University. Television came first: he played Dr. Phillip Chandler on St. Elsewhere from 1982 to 1988.

He won the Best Supporting Actor Oscar for Glory (1989), was nominated for Malcolm X (1992), and won Best Actor for Training Day (2001). He played the football coach Herman Boone in Remember the Titans (2000).

He directed and starred in Fences (2016), adapted from August Wilson’s play, and received the Presidential Medal of Freedom in 2022.
